[package]
name = "ratatui-core"
version = "0.1.2"
description = "    Core types and traits for the Ratatui Terminal UI library.\n    Widget libraries should use this crate. Applications should use the main Ratatui crate.\n"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/ratatui-core"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/ratatui/ratatui"
homepage = "https://ratatui.rs"
keywords = ["dashboard", "terminal", "tui"]
categories = ["command-line-interface"]
license = "MIT"
exclude = ["*.log", ".github", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "Makefile.toml", "assets/*", "tags"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88.0"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[package.metadata.cargo-udeps.ignore]
normal = ["critical-section"]
development = ["critical-section"]

[features]
default = []
std = ["bitflags/std", "compact_str/std", "itertools/use_std", "kasuari/std", "palette?/std", "serde?/std", "strum/std", "thiserror/std", "unicode-truncate/std"]
layout-cache = ["dep:critical-section"]
anstyle = ["dep:anstyle"]
palette = ["dep:palette"]
portable-atomic = ["kasuari/portable-atomic"]
underline-color = []
scrolling-regions = []
serde = ["bitflags/serde", "compact_str/serde", "dep:serde"]

[dependencies]
bitflags = "2.9"
hashbrown = "0.17"
lru = "0.18"
unicode-segmentation = "1.9"
unicode-width = ">=0.2.0"
[dependencies.anstyle]
optional = true
version = "1.0.3"

[dependencies.compact_str]
version = "0.10"
default-features = false

[dependencies.critical-section]
optional = true
version = "1.2"

[dependencies.document-features]
optional = true
version = "0.2.11"

[dependencies.itertools]
version = "0.15"
default-features = false
features = ["use_alloc"]

[dependencies.kasuari]
default-features = false
version = "0.4.9"

[dependencies.palette]
optional = true
version = "0.7.7"
default-features = false
features = ["libm"]

[dependencies.serde]
optional = true
version = "1.0.219"
default-features = false
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.strum]
version = "0.28"
default-features = false
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.thiserror]
default-features = false
version = "2.0.12"

[dependencies.unicode-truncate]
default-features = false
version = "2"

[dev-dependencies]
indoc = "2.0.5"
pretty_assertions = "1"
rstest = "0.26"
serde_json = "1.0.142"
[dev-dependencies.critical-section]
features = ["std"]
version = "1.2"

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "allow"
cast_possible_wrap = "allow"
cast_precision_loss = "allow"
cast_sign_loss = "allow"
missing_errors_doc = "allow"
missing_panics_doc = "allow"
module_name_repetitions = "allow"
must_use_candidate = "allow"
module_inception = "allow"
as_underscore = "warn"
deref_by_slicing = "warn"
else_if_without_else = "warn"
empty_line_after_doc_comments = "warn"
equatable_if_let = "warn"
fn_to_numeric_cast_any = "warn"
format_push_string = "warn"
implicit_clone = "warn"
map_err_ignore = "warn"
missing_const_for_fn = "warn"
mixed_read_write_in_expression = "warn"
mod_module_files = "warn"
needless_pass_by_ref_mut = "warn"
needless_raw_strings = "warn"
or_fun_call = "warn"
redundant_type_annotations = "warn"
rest_pat_in_fully_bound_structs = "warn"
string_lit_chars_any = "warn"
string_slice = "warn"
unnecessary_self_imports = "warn"
use_self = "warn"

[lints.clippy.pedantic]
level = "warn"
priority = -1
